provenance_entry.mathematical_definition: P_i = H(source entities || transformation rule || release version)
provenance_entry.economic_definition: Stable pointer to the entities, activities and agents that generated an observation.
provenance_entry.economic_mechanism: Accountability, auditability and reproducibility of measurement.
provenance_entry.hypothesis_role: Every economic value must be reversible to its primary evidence and transformation.
provenance_entry.source_mapping: source transaction/log keys, transformation rule id, code version and release manifest
provenance_entry.missing_value_rule: Never optional for released processed observations.
provenance_entry.validation_rule: Hash is deterministic; referenced source objects and rules exist and pass checksums.
provenance_entry.measurement_limitations: A hash proves identity/integrity of cited inputs, not semantic correctness by itself.

note: Conceptual dictionary formulas are not universal physical primary-key implementations. Native keys and code formulas in data_model.csv take precedence.
